description: Test vectors for the LightChain x402 prepaid-debit scheme (docs/x402/lightchain-scheme.md). Each vector is one facilitator verify/settle input (paymentRequirements, paymentPayload) plus the chain state it is evaluated against. expect.invalidReason is the facilitator's x402 reason; expect.revert is the JobRegistry custom error for the same authorization and chain state, omitted when the contract would accept it (an envelope fault only a facilitator sees). Contract tests run the vectors that are valid or have a revert. Generated by scripts/x402-vectors; do not edit by hand.
warning: Every key here is a publicly known Foundry/Anvil test key. Never use one on a real network.
mnemonic: test test test test test test test test test test test junk
typeString: DebitAuthorization(address payer,address payTo,address facilitator,uint256 maxAmount,uint256 deadline,bytes32 nonce)

vectors.name: valid-testnet
vectors.description: A valid authorization for exactly the job fee on testnet.

vectors.name: valid-mainnet
vectors.description: A valid authorization for exactly the job fee on mainnet.

vectors.name: valid-at-deadline
vectors.description: Settled in the block whose timestamp equals the deadline: still valid.

vectors.name: valid-self-settled
vectors.description: The resource server settles itself (facilitator = payTo); no delegate authorization is needed.

vectors.name: valid-below-cap
vectors.description: The cap is twice the fee; only the fee is debited.

vectors.name: expired
vectors.description: Settled one second after the deadline.

vectors.name: wrong-facilitator
vectors.description: The authorization names another facilitator than the one settling.

vectors.name: wrong-pay-to
vectors.description: The authorization pays another address than the owner of the session the job goes into.

vectors.name: facilitator-not-authorized
vectors.description: The session owner (payTo) has not authorized the facilitator as its delegate.

vectors.name: replayed
vectors.description: The nonce was already used by an earlier settlement.

vectors.name: wrong-payer
vectors.description: Signed by another key than the payer it names.

vectors.name: wrong-chain
vectors.description: Signed for chain 9200 against the testnet JobRegistry address, settled on testnet (8200).

vectors.name: high-s-signature
vectors.description: The valid signature's high-s twin: it recovers to the payer but is malleable, so it is refused.

vectors.name: over-cap
vectors.description: The cap is one wei below the job fee.

vectors.name: expired-and-replayed
vectors.description: Two faults at once: the earlier check in the specification's order (the deadline) decides.

vectors.name: insufficient-balance
vectors.description: The payer's prepaid balance is one wei below the job fee.

vectors.name: x402-version-1
vectors.description: A version 1 payload; this scheme is version 2 only.

vectors.name: unsupported-scheme
vectors.description: Requirements for another scheme.

vectors.name: unsupported-network
vectors.description: Requirements for a network this scheme does not run on.

vectors.name: malformed-signature
vectors.description: A 64-byte signature: the facilitator refuses the payload; on chain it decodes and fails the signature check.

vectors.name: accepted-mismatch
vectors.description: The payload claims to accept a lower amount than the server requires.

vectors.name: wrong-asset
vectors.description: The requirements name the mainnet JobRegistry on testnet.

vectors.name: wrong-domain-version
vectors.description: The requirements advertise EIP-712 domain version 2.

vectors.name: requirements-name-another-facilitator
vectors.description: The requirements name a facilitator other than the one verifying (msgSender).
